title: Quarterly bus reliability review (synthetic)
audience: The service-planning team and two council transport officers of an invented regional bus network (Orrin Valley Transit), reviewing Q3 2026 results over a video call; numerate, comfortable with tables, short on time.

core_message.text: On-time departures fell from 86% to 81% in Q3, almost all of it on the two cross-town routes through the roadworks.
Away from the roadworks reliability held, so the drop is a diversion problem, not a fleet or staffing one.
Retiming the two cross-town routes for the diversion is the fix to test in Q4, with a check at the end of January.

constraints: Synthetic topic: every figure comes from the research pack, whose data is invented; never research further and never present it as real.
The deck project already has an AGENTS.md (the fixture in this brief's project/ folder): merge the skill's process into it, never overwrite it.
Every chart labels axes with units, states its baseline and shows the comparison period; quantities come with their baseline or prior quarter.
One results table by route; one glossary of the reliability terms; one timeline of the roadworks phases; a summary tile row; discussion prompts on the closing slide.
Charts are new visual language for this deck: prototype them or record the presenter's in-situ choice; build them from the diagram kit, not a charting library.
Flag the disputed cause of the October dip rather than choosing one; quote the driver report verbatim.
Hand off an editable PPTX and re-flow it into the network's plain template; review at 1920x1080, 1280x720 and 1288x598.
